import json, subprocess, sys, os
CAND = ['python3','/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py']
W='/workspace/tmp/t/work'
m = {"version":1,"seed":1,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,
     "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8:aa00::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
open(W+'/p.json','w').write(json.dumps(m))
plan = json.loads(subprocess.run(CAND+['plan',W+'/p.json'],capture_output=True).stdout)['probes'][0]
tid = plan['target']; pid = plan['id']
sent, dl = plan['sent_ms'], plan['deadline_ms']
def row(**over):
    d = {"probe_id":pid,"received_ms":sent,"target":tid,"source":tid,"type":129,"code":0}
    for k,v in over.items():
        if v is ...: del d[k]
        else: d[k] = v
    return d
cases = [
  (b'not json', 'json'),
  (b'\xef\xbb\xbf{}', 'json'),
  (b'{"probe_id":"%s","probe_id":"%s"}' % (pid.encode(), pid.encode()), 'json'),
  (b'{"probe_id":"%s","received_ms":NaN,"target":"%s","source":"%s","type":129,"code":0}' % (pid.encode(), tid.encode(), tid.encode()), 'json'),
  (b'[]', 'schema'),
  (b'null', 'schema'),
  (b'{}', 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(extra=1)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(code=...)).encode().replace(b'"code": ...', b''), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(probe_id="")).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(probe_id="x"*201, target="bogus")).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(probe_id=5)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(received_ms=True)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=None)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(code=1.0)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(target=1)).encode(), 'schema'),
  (json.dumps(row(target="bogus")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(target="2001:db9::1")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(target="::1")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(target=tid+"%eth0")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(source=" 2001:db8::1")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(source="2001:db8::1/64")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(source="1.2.3.4")).encode(), 'address'),
  (json.dumps(row(probe_id="w/s/9/low-1/0")).encode(), 'unknown_probe'),
  (json.dumps(row(probe_id="x"*200)).encode(), 'unknown_probe'),
  (json.dumps(row(target="2001:db8:aa00::2")).encode(), 'target_mismatch'),
  (json.dumps(row(target="2001:0DB8:AA00:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001")).encode(), None),  # canonical same
  (json.dumps(row(received_ms=dl)).encode(), 'time'),
  (json.dumps(row(received_ms=dl-1)).encode(), None),
  (json.dumps(row(received_ms=sent-1, type=7)).encode(), 'time'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=129, code=1)).encode(), 'icmp'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=1, code=7)).encode(), 'icmp'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=1, code=-1)).encode(), 'icmp'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=1, code=6)).encode(), None),
  (json.dumps(row(type=1, code=0)).encode(), None),
  (json.dumps(row(type=0, code=0)).encode(), 'icmp'),
  (json.dumps(row(type=3, code=1)).encode(), 'icmp'),
]
lines = b'\n'.join(c[0] for c in cases) + b'\n'
open(W+'/p.jsonl','wb').write(lines)
r = subprocess.run(CAND+['replay',W+'/p.json',W+'/p.jsonl'],capture_output=True)
res = json.loads(r.stdout)
fails = []
for i,(raw, want) in enumerate(cases, 1):
    got = None
    for d in res['diagnostics']:
        if d['line'] == i: got = d['reason']
    if got != want:
        fails.append((i, want, got, raw[:70]))
print('accepted', res['accepted_rows'], 'dup', res['duplicate_rows'])
print('precedence failures:', len(fails))
for f in fails: print(' ', f)
PYEOF
